products.name: Dual-facing dash cam
products.summary: Forward road camera plus driver-facing cabin camera with event recording.
products.description: Records the road ahead and the cab at 1080p. Hard braking and collisions save a clip automatically. Cloud upload over LTE for fleet review.

products.name: AI driver safety camera
products.summary: Camera with in-cab alerts for distraction, tailgating and phone use.
products.description: On-device AI detects distracted driving, following too closely and phone use, and coaches the driver with audio alerts. Events sync to a fleet dashboard.

products.name: 4-channel backup and side camera system
products.summary: Rear and side cameras with an in-cab monitor to remove blind spots.
products.description: Four weatherproof cameras with a 7-inch quad-view monitor. Reverse trigger switches the rear view to full screen.

products.name: Plug-in GPS tracker
products.summary: OBD-II plug-in tracker for live location, trips and engine diagnostics.
products.description: Installs in minutes in the OBD-II port. Live map, trip history, idle time, harsh driving and fault codes. Open API for dispatch and routing software.

products.name: ELD and hours-of-service telematics unit
products.summary: Hard-wired ELD with hours of service, DVIR and fuel reporting.
products.description: Compliant electronic logging device with driver app for hours of service and inspections. Also reports location, fuel use and engine data.

products.name: Battery-powered asset tracker
products.summary: Wireless tracker for trailers and equipment with multi-year battery.
products.description: No wiring needed. Reports location a few times a day to locate trailers, generators and equipment. Geofence alerts when assets move.

products.name: Modular van shelving system
products.summary: Lightweight aluminum shelves, bins and drawers for cargo vans.
products.description: Configurable shelving with dividers, parts bins and lockable drawers. Bolts to factory mounting points.

products.name: Drop-down ladder rack
products.summary: Ladder rack that lowers to shoulder height for safer loading.
products.description: Gas-assisted drop-down rack reduces roof climbing and back strain. Holds up to two extension ladders.

products.name: LED warning beacon
products.summary: Magnetic or permanent-mount amber LED beacon with multiple flash patterns.
products.description: Bright amber LED beacon for service and utility vehicles. Several flash patterns, low power draw.

products.name: 2000 W pure sine inverter kit
products.summary: Runs power tools and laptops from the vehicle battery.
products.description: Pure sine wave inverter with remote switch and install kit. Low-voltage cutoff protects the starting battery.

products.name: Vehicle immobilizer and alarm
products.summary: Prevents engine start without a driver key fob; alarm on forced entry.
products.description: Theft deterrent with driver ID fobs, siren and tamper alerts. Can integrate with telematics for remote notifications.

products.name: Push-to-talk over cellular radio
products.summary: Nationwide two-way radio over LTE with group and private calls.
products.description: Mobile PTT radio that works anywhere with cellular coverage. Group calls, private calls and dispatcher console.

specs.Features: Group calls, private calls, GPS location

products.name: Service body upfit package
products.summary: Utility service body with compartments, lighting and power coordinated as one upfit.
products.description: Coordinated upfit of a service body with compartment lighting, inverter and racks, installed through qualified upfitters.
